biotools.summary: SWIBRID is a tool for profiling genomic junctions generated during antibody class switch recombination in B cells to detect immune deficiencies and DNA repair defects. It utilizes long-read sequencing and bioinformatics analysis to classify these defects and identify patient-specific signatures.
